description: Expected results for the official RHESSys W8 test case (RHESSys git, Testing/ folder, TestCase.Rmd): W8 catchment of the HJ Andrews forest (Oregon), 1988-10-01..2000-10-01, legacy basin daily output (-b) with growth mode (-g), the exact command line and parameters of TestCase.Rmd. inputs/ are the unmodified files from git HEAD f9d1bbf. Values recorded from our own clean runs through the KI tool run_rhessys.py: two runs gave byte-identical output, and the KI-tool run gave byte-identical output to running the official Rmd command directly. Tolerances are 1e-5 relative (outputs are printed with 6 decimals).
engine_version: rhessys7.4 (makefile VERSION 7.4; the binary's -version prints 'RHESSys Version: 5.14.3'); built from RHESSys git f9d1bbf WITH one uncommitted local edit in rhessys/cycle/canopy_stratum_daily_F.c (see README)

numeric_checks.name: n_days_basin
numeric_checks.why: daily basin output 1989-10-01..2000-09-30 (tec print_daily_on 1989-10-01; first year is spin-up)

numeric_checks.name: n_days_grow
numeric_checks.why: daily growth (carbon/nitrogen) basin output, same days

numeric_checks.name: last_date
numeric_checks.why: last printed day (yyyymmdd); run ends 2000-10-01 hour 1

numeric_checks.name: precip_sum_mm
numeric_checks.why: total precipitation over printed days (input climate passes through correctly)

numeric_checks.name: sat_def_mean_mm
numeric_checks.why: mean saturation deficit (soil water storage state)

numeric_checks.name: lai_mean
numeric_checks.why: mean leaf area index (vegetation growth, -g mode)

numeric_checks.name: water_balance_max3day_abs_mm
numeric_checks.why: RHESSys's own WaterBalanceTest (rhessys/test/rhessystest.py): max 3-day mean |daily water balance error|; official pass limit is < 1e-5

reference: Official base output reference/base_basin_daily.csv (and Testing/W8TestCase.RData, same content) was made with the output filter reference/testing_filter.yml. It is NOT used as the pass gate: (1) this engine segfaults when given that filter (-of), so the same file cannot be made; (2) comparing our legacy output with it in the same units, means differ: streamflow +0.40%, sat_deficit -0.82%, rz_storage -5.87%, LAI -4.32%, snowpack +0.20% (litter C about -22%). TestCase.Rmd gives no pass limit for these, only says differences above +-4e-6 per day should be understood. Likely cause: the base was made with another code version and/or this engine has a local edit; not checked further (no engine rebuild allowed).
notes: The official water balance test from rhessys/test/rhessystest.py (ZERO = 1e-5 on the max 3-day moving mean of |error|) is applied to this run and passes (2.33e-6).
